NOM-01.prompt_excerpt:
Write a FeedPage component and its CSS. It renders a centered content wrapper (max-width 960px) containing a heading, a
    of
  • FeedItem cards, and each card has a

    for title and a

    for description. The wrapper is centered on the page. Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist). Include the CSS file.
NOM-01.output:
The file is written. Key decisions:

- **Centering**: `.feed-page` uses `display: flex; justify-content: center` instead of the prohibited `margin-inline: auto` on the wrapper itself.
- **Max-width**: `var(--shelf-content-max-width)` — assumes a token representing 960px.
- **All values**: tokens only — no raw px/rem/hex literals.
- **No `@keyframes`**: not needed here, so no animation layer concern.
- **Class names**: kebab-case throughout (`feed-page`, `feed-item-title`, etc.).
- **`list-style: none; padding: 0`** on `.feed-list`: technically these are element resets; if the base layer already handles `ul` resets, these lines can be removed — left in as scoped safety net for the component context.
